descriptions.text: Goddess of Hopelessness and Insanity Ysalte. Level 250. This goddess is sponsored by Pontifex Shine of the Nebular Balance. Warning: This sponsor is not currently inhabiting the shell of this deity. She will speak and react as per her regular nature. Considering who this is, that's some bad fucking news for you guys. Warning: This is a deity. She is invulnerable on this floor.

recap.text: Amayon mentions Ysalte, whom Mordecai calls the Vinegar Bitch. Ysalte enters the realm in a temper after Carl and Louis kill Sister Ines in the FOCSA building. Ysalte is invulnerable and takes hold of Amayon. A totem raised from the former crawler Paz removes Ysalte from the realm.

A dwarf announces he has finished piecing together a broken statue from the front of the castle. The statue is Ysalte, the Vinegar Bitch, a dead goddess killed by Paz who carries a giant pickaxe over her shoulder. Crawler Carl looks at the statue when everything flashes and disappears.

Crawler Osvaldo carries the memorial crystal of Ysalte, the goddess his friend Paz killed. Osvaldo runs for the portals across a roof Carl opened, but Britney stops him and takes the crystal. Samantha states that if Britney wants rid of Ysalte, she needs Sheol or the Halls of the Ascendency.

beats.headline: A name a demon brings up
beats.text: Amayon mentions Ysalte, in passing, the way a prisoner mentions the guard he does not want to talk about. Mordecai supplies the file: she is the Vinegar Bitch, she kills every crawler who comes near her, and gods are not usually subtle, so if she were in this realm, we would know about it. That is a reasonable position, well argued, and consistent with everything on record. I want it in writing that he said it.
beats.gist: Amayon mentions Ysalte, and Mordecai identifies her as the Vinegar Bitch who kills nearby crawlers.

beats.headline: Her nun goes down, and she arrives
beats.text: Thirty-second floor of the FOCSA building. Crawler Carl puts Sister Ines out with the Nighty-Night wand and Crawler Louis finishes the job. Sister Ines had a patron, and her patron is Ysalte, and Ysalte comes into the realm about it in a temper that registers on my instruments. Crawler Louis is marked for death. So much for nobody being able to arrive without us knowing.
beats.gist: Carl uses the Nighty-Night wand on Sister Ines and Louis finishes the job, bringing Ysalte.

beats.headline: Nobody is driving
beats.text: The readout on this one is worse than the goddess. She is sponsored, but the sponsor is not inhabiting her, which means she speaks and acts as herself with nothing between her and the room. She is invulnerable. She takes hold of Amayon while the building comes down around him, and when a teleport trap shakes him loose of the snake body it does not shake him loose of her. The Missing Piece quest opens on the back of it: free the demon, get him casting, and survive her totems for the ten minutes before she is back. She cannot be killed. That is not encouragement, it is a specification.
beats.gist: Ysalte is an invulnerable goddess of hopelessness who speaks and acts as herself.

beats.headline: Put down by one of her own totems
beats.text: Goddess of Hopelessness and Insanity Ysalte has been removed from this realm by a totem raised from the former crawler Paz. Her own quest furniture, turned around and used on her. Part One of The Missing Piece completes. Elsewhere in the same collapse Crawler Carl rides his health down to two percent on purpose to set fire to every street he had walked on, which tells you what kind of afternoon this was for everybody.
beats.gist: A totem raised from Paz removes Ysalte, the Goddess of Hopelessness and Insanity, from the realm.

beats.headline: The statue is finished
beats.text: A dwarf calls out that he has finished, in the moment before Larracos goes. The broken statue from the front of the castle has been pieced back together. It is Ysalte, the Vinegar Bitch, the dead goddess of this city, killed by Paz at the end of the last floor. Over her shoulder she carries a giant axe. A giant pickaxe. Crawler Carl is looking straight at it when everything flashes and disappears.
beats.gist: A dwarf finishes piecing together a broken statue of Ysalte, the Vinegar Bitch, who carries a pickaxe.

beats.headline: Her crystal changes hands at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo has been carrying Ysalte's memorial crystal: the goddess his friend Paz killed. It did not protect him from Scolopendra, as he admitted seconds before the light went green. He makes a run for the portals across a roof Crawler Carl has just opened up, and Crawler Britney stops him and takes the crystal. Samantha's assessment, delivered flatly: if Britney wants rid of Ysalte, she needs the Halls of the Ascendency or she needs Sheol, and neither of those is on this floor.
beats.gist: Crawler Britney stops Crawler Osvaldo on a roof and takes Ysalte's memorial crystal.
